text:
maya: Quick async check — morning run. Observed sustained queue growth for short-gen jobs in ap-southeast-1. What I did: kicked a targeted warmup for model v2-small and bumped lane weights for prewarm pool. Blockers: hitting quota floor on GPUs in ap-southeast-1 (A100s). Today: filing quota request and prepping a eu-west1 canary. CC @alex @jin

alex: Saw the telemetry. Queue depth +27% over last hour, avg token latency +120ms. Can you paste the exact `kubectl`/tooling commands you used?

maya: Ran this quick one-liner to scale and monitor: `kubectl -n inference scale deployment prewarm-worker --replicas=8`
`./tools/queue-monitor --region=ap-southeast-1 --metric=queued --window=5m`

alex: Nice. FYI PR #3421 (autoscaler tweak) just merged — should reduce tailing queue bursts short-term. I can escalate the cloud quota but need exact counts and instance types.

maya: Current snapshot: 42 x A100-80 (ap-southeast-1), reserved commit 30. Also 8 x A100-40 in eu-west1 for warmups. Requesting +20 A100-80 in ap-southeast to reestablish headroom. Filing ticket in #vendors/cloud-requests now.

jin: I'll attach the prewarm perf logs to that ticket. Also noticed one eu-west1 node OOM'd yesterday during a long warmup — investigating whether it's model memory or host flakiness.

ops-bot: Created cloud request CR-2026-98 for quota increase (ap-southeast-1, +20 A100-80). Estimated vendor ETA: 48h.

tara: Heads-up — Dedicated customers in AMS1 flagged higher latencies if we shift traffic. If we re-route heavy lanes to eu-west1, please notify #eng-sre and update the routing policy.

maya: :thumbsup: Will coordinate the routing note. Blocker: need a canary owner for eu-west1 warmup tomorrow morning (08:00 UTC). @jin can you take the lead?

jin: I can run the canary and own rollback. Plan: 2k invocations, 30m duration, metrics posted in this thread. Will post the exact runbook and thresholds by EOD.

alex: Quick config request — can we reduce prewarm cache TTL to 60s for these short-gen lanes? It shaved token cost in the last run.

maya: I'll open a small PR to flip TTL and tag you for review. ETA ~2h.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: eu-west1 cluster, start 08:00 UTC, load 2000 invocations, expected 30m. Canary ID: canary-2026-6429.

maya: Thanks all. I'm on-call today so ping here for urgent handoffs. Will update the cloud-ticket and drop logs once jin posts the canary runbook. :wave:
